name: guest_subst
description: Managed-code substitutions for single-threaded zkVM guests (ILC stage)
note: No native object: this module carries the ILC-stage inputs. substitutions: ILLink.Substitutions XML that stubs method bodies and folds feature fields; bflat applies it before the user's --substitution files and rejects duplicates, so users extend it and do not override it. An entry is here because the guest has one hart. Floating point is not a reason: soft-float arithmetic and the exact libm operations run.
